# dsh-minimax-byapi
Native MiniMax for DeepSeek Harness: chat with a subscription (M Plan) key or a pay-as-you-go API ke
y, plus image, video, speech, speech-to-text and music tools over the official MiniMax API.
[](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-minimax-byapi/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.c
om/package/dsh-minimax-byapi) [](LICENSE) [](#compatibility) [](#compatibility) [](https://github.co
m/topics/dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
English | 中文
> **Published on npm.** `dsh plugin add dsh-minimax-byapi` installs the released package; a git clon
e or a local checkout works too — see Install.
One plugin, one MiniMax connection. Chat models appear in the model picker; image, video, speech and
music models stay out of it and are used through tools instead. Any chat model — MiniMax or another
provider — can call those tools. The plugin talks to the official MiniMax open platform, keeps the
API key in the dsh credential service, and saves generated media locally. It is not an OAuth client,
does not provide an account or quota, and does not read any MiniMax CLI token.
## Features
| Area | Current scope |
| Chat provider | Registers a native dsh LLM provider: route `minimax-byapi`, display name **MiniMax
**. Streaming text and tool calls go through the official pi-ai adapter, over either the OpenAI-comp

atible or the Anthropic-compatible route. |
| Model catalog | `GET {root}/v1/models` discovery, merg
ed with the plugin's built-in model constants, auto-categorized as chat, image, video, speech, music

, research, or unknown. Only chat models enter the picker. Per-model overrides are available. |
| Co
nnection presets | Five access modes: pay-as-you-go (international / China) and M Plan subscription
(international / China), plus a custom endpoint. The preset fills the base URL and the chat protocol

. |
| Settings page | Access mode, API address, API key, verification, timeout, the chat-model table
(the picker's source of truth), and media-model selection. Copy follows the dsh language (English o

r Chinese). |
| Durable media tasks | Task records are per session and survive restarts. Downloads w
rite `.part` files and are renamed after validation. A failed download can be retried without regene

rating, so nothing is billed twice. |
| Results in chat | Tool result cards, file preview, and a sid
ebar player for MP4, MP3 and WAV. Tool cards and the player follow the dsh language. |
The plugin registers two components: `minimax-byapi` (chat, model catalog, settings page) and `dsh-m
inimax-media` (media tools). Together they register 13 tools:
| Tool | What it does |
| `minimax_models` | Refreshes the catalog and returns models grouped by capability. Optional `verif

y_key` checks address and key with one `GET /v1/models`. |
| `minimax_quota` | Reads the M Plan rema
ining quota and reset times (5-hour and weekly windows). Subscription key only — a pay-as-you-go key

is refused. |
| `minimax_generate_image` | Text to image: `prompt`, optional `model`, aspect ratio,

`n` (1–9, default 1), style settings for `image-01-live`. |
| `minimax_edit_image` | Image to image

: `prompt` plus a reference image (`subject_reference`). |

## Compatibility
| Component | Requirement | Verified |
ted Web profile: install, load, both components running, settings page rendered. Chat and media call

s still need a real key — see VALIDATION.md |
| Node.js | `>=22.19.0` | CI runs Node 22.19 and 24 on

Linux and Windows |
| MiniMax | Official open platform, international (`api.minimax.io`) or China (
`api.minimaxi.com` / `api.minimax.cn`) | Chat verified live with a real key on the China M Plan rout

e; the media endpoints are documented only — see VALIDATION.md |
| Other dsh 0.2.x | Inside the `eng
ines.dsh` range | Not individually verified |
`engines.dsh` is the compatibility gate; `peerDependencies` pin the SDK packages the source uses but
do not decide compatibility, so rerun the integration tests after a dsh upgrade.
## Connection and the two kinds of key
MiniMax issues two kinds of credential, and the plugin treats them the same way on the wire:
| | Pay-as-you-go API key | M Plan subscription key |

| Prefix | standard key | `sk-cp-…` |
| Header | `Authorization: Bearer <key>` | **Identical** — `Au

thorization: Bearer sk-cp-…` |
| Hosts | same hosts | same hosts |
| Billing | deducts account balan

ce | deducts M Plan quota, then credits, then balance |
| Model tiers | all available models | plan
tier decides which models you may call |
[该节后续省略]
## Capabilities
## Permissions and privacy
- **Network:** only the MiniMax endpoint you configure. Discovery calls `GET {root}/v1/models`, chat
uses the configured route, and the media tools call the image, video, speech, speech-to-text and mu

sic endpoints on the same host. No telemetry, no analytics, no third-party service.
- **Credentials:
** the key lives in the dsh credential service under the reference name `MINIMAX_API_KEY`; it is not
written to YAML, to logs, to task records or to the repository. Media download requests are sent to

MiniMax's own file host and carry no separate credential.
- **Files:** generated media goes to `$DS
H_HOME/plugins/dsh-minimax-byapi` (or `media.dataDir`). Task records may contain time-limited upstre

am URLs; treat them as private.
- **Data leaves your machine:** prompts, the reference images you at
tach, the audio you upload for transcription and the text you synthesize are sent to MiniMax to be p
rocessed, exactly as you send them in the chat prompt. The plugin does not filter, redact or re-host

that content.
- **Not done by this plugin:** reading or reusing a MiniMax CLI token, installing or
running other plugins, fetching runtime dependencies at install time, calling the server-side web se
arch tool, voice cloning or voice design.
Installing any dsh plugin runs third-party code with your user permissions, and tool approvals do no
t sandbox plugin code — review the source before installing. Please report security issues through S
lugin code — review the source before installing. Please report security issues through SECURITY.md.
